canonical_project: Essor Services / Kaia Energy data center (waste-to-energy powered)
notes: Announced July 2024: consulting firm Essor Services partnered with Costa Rican clean-energy firm Kaia Energy to build a data center powered by a ~12 MW waste-to-energy plant converting household waste to electricity. Construction was planned to start Oct 2024 with completion targeted Nov 2025 (DCD; wearetech.africa). Exact site not publicly specified (assumed Ouagadougou region); no follow-up evidence of construction/completion found as of Aug 2026, so status kept as announced and 12 MW refers to the power plant, not data center capacity.
